records.description_rewritten: Praia 19 is the southern, LGBT-popular naturist section of Praia da Bela Vista on Costa da Caparica. Almada municipality explicitly identifies the southern section as a nude-bathing area attracting LGBT visitors; an independent gay travel directory also describes longtime cruising in pine woods beyond the beach. The original cruising site links meetings to wooded sections beyond the former beach-train line near its nineteenth stop. Posts from May 2026 include firsthand visitors, questions about approaches and descriptions of sexual encounters in dunes, giving more current community evidence than most candidates. This is a protected coastal landscape: nudism and consensual private encounters do not remove requirements to protect dune habitats or beach visitors.
records.location_identity: Praia 19, southern Praia da Bela Vista, Almada/Costa da Caparica. Original claimed wooded area beyond beach train stop 19, not the entire concession beach; exact vegetation paths must not be assumed open.
records.access_conditions: Access by marked walking paths and beach approaches; municipality lists parking and seasonal concession toilets at northern Bela Vista but these are not on the remote southern cruising area. Dune and pine vegetation is protected; never advocate trespass through fenced dunes or off-trail habitat. North-side amenities not necessarily close to remote beach.
